title: Prove real Worker dense cuts expired replay and exact cold writing
detail: The ordinary writer-on release-profile app passes the unchanged genuine original/Joined Worker floor, two-way writing and cold-opening case. A separate test-only Worker build lowers only live page preparation remaining records to3, with exact source/mutation hashes; no authentication, chain, witness, crypto, native commit or erasure guard changes. Two genuine full-app journeys independently bind four separately committed service decisions to their saved envelope/response, close the receiver, reopen offline under its real Account cohort, and catch up. After local add/Undo, a separate read-only custody/carrier observer uses the correct existing promotion or Joined permit, authenticates its own native floor and returns syntax counts only. It cannot grant semantic trust; app admission/cold are separate. Saved native custody/content rows must remain byte-digest identical. Both directions show one2-entry physical page and a resumed1-entry physical page at firstEntry2. After31real seconds both original requests have expired; offline cold exports equal the complete pre-Undo Markdown entry archive, and the retained journal is recovered. The original request/page is deliberately stored in two self-contained extents; the two native receipts are7,531bytes each original-to-Joined and7,529bytes each Joined-to-original. No process-local page registry, format conversion or persisted trust is introduced.
validation: Both final directions pass on identical canonical source: original-to-Joined50470ms and Joined-to-original55349ms. Each has floor1, a2-entry head and nonzero-entry tail, unchanged observed native rows,2retained durable journal entries and exact cold export; local Undo preserves all received writing. Existing ordinary full-app floor case passes19.9s. Initial fixture build and retry fail on a Window-transformed source; scoping the uniquely anchored lower allowance to Worker builds passes with five exact mutations and zero repeated transforms. All initial native attempts remain: Page-only response observer missed uploads; SQLite now independently verifies actual accepted rows; immediate ownership check needed saved seed readiness and real cohort locks; inverse text on absent notice was corrected to no matching integrity notice; Joined observation used the wrong promotion permit and is corrected without parser changes; the new empty-journal assumption was removed because retained durable journal entries are legitimate and exact cold recovery is stronger evidence. Every failed artifact set is copied before rerun. Types, quality, format,17registry checks, inventory and10controls pass. An initially unmapped family is registered required, preserving all old policy bytes/obligations. No canonical runtime/crypto hash changes, no old test edits. Latest full unit checkpoint remains419, predating420/421 new tests. Ordinary/control assets have no old lab modules or new observation code; exact asset identities are retained. Before freeze, an unfrozen caption generalized the original-direction7,531bytes to both directions. It is corrected to the raw7,531/7,529byte observations; prior caption/config remain artifacts. No runtime or test change.
summary: Real original/Joined Worker dense cuts, firstEntry2 tails,31s request expiry, offline cold exactness, local Undo and pending-journal recovery pass in both directions. Native observer is read-only and syntax-only. All app guards/source remain unchanged; failed harness attempts are preserved and the new family is required.
limitations: The lower allowance is a test-only Worker fixture; this gives no RAM/performance or unmodified-image rollback acceptance credit. Multi-request partial cuts, binary retained-reading installation, every floor rewrite/lost reply, frozen old Page/Worker/stale tabs, actual stale-turn idle audit and same-tree writer-off image remain. Stage5 full gates and Stage6 are not run. No format/trust/rate/gate/deadline change, commit, publication or deployment.
decisionTitle: Prove native dense lifecycle with read-only observations and durable journal recovery
decision: Force the approved interior cut by lowering only a test Worker live allowance, leaving every guard intact. Prove real Account ownership with known owner bootstraps plus native shared leases/exclusive supervisor. Bind uploads independently from committed service rows, observe native receipt syntax only after locking under the correct existing authenticated permit, and require saved rows unchanged. Do not require a durable journal to be empty: retain it and prove exact offline cold recovery. Keep actual old-artifact/rollback images and performance gates separate.
next: Test a partial first page in a multi-request G8/B batch, repair any confirmed chain-order defect within existing guards, then complete authenticated installing-floor/rewriter/lost-reply lifecycles, frozen old artifacts, actual stale-turn idle audit and same-tree writer-off rollback image. Continue automatically after each freeze.
